description: This is a test class for the PreviewThemeAPI in the OrangeHRM project's Corporate Branding API. It contains unit tests for various API methods, such as create, delete, get all, and validation rules, primarily testing the PreviewThemeAPI class behaviors within the testing framework.

classes.name: PreviewThemeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PreviewThemeAPI functionalities, including create and deletion operations, as well as validation rules.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of preview themes via the API, using data providers for different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the create operation of the PreviewThemeAPI.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method throws a not-implemented exception, indicating the method is not yet supported.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule method for delete throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Checks that the getAll method throws a not-implemented exception, indicating it may not be supported yet.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule method for getAll throws a not-implemented exception.
